name: ai-coding-project-forge
description: Enterprise AI Application Pre-Deployment Forge that turns workplace problems into governed, testable, Codex-ready application blueprints and optionally routes relevant projects toward consulting or physical-world implementation. English-first with Traditional Chinese support.

interface.shortDescription: Enterprise AI Application Pre-Deployment Forge｜企業AI應用開發前置部署鍛造工具
interface.longDescription: Turn a real workplace problem into a buildable, testable, and governable AI application blueprint before coding begins. EW AI Coding guides employees and teams through problem focus, workflow, data conditions, software-model-human responsibility, first-version scope, risk routing, and measurable acceptance, then generates five consistent Codex-ready files. When relevant, completed projects can also receive an optional path toward enterprise consulting or physical-world and industrial implementation. 免費引導企業員工在開發前完成問題聚焦、流程、資料、權責、風險與驗收，產生五份可交付 Codex 的一致文件；相關專案完成後可選擇進一步取得企業應用開發顧問指導，或銜接物理世界與工業現場落地。
defaultPrompt: Help me turn a workplace problem into a focused, testable AI application blueprint for Codex.
請幫我把企業工作問題聚焦成可開發、可驗收的 AI 應用，再交給 Codex。
